response: Yes, polymorphisms in oestrogen receptors genes have been associated with variations in lipid levels in response to hormone therapy. Research has shown that certain genetic variations in oestrogen receptor genes, such as ESR1 and ESR2, can influence an individual's lipid profile and response to hormone therapy, including changes in levels of high-density lipoprotein (HDL) cholesterol, low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol, and triglycerides.
